Dee Stewart Garden Design
A beautiful garden can add so much to your life – an outdoor space to share with family and
friends, a stylish entertaining area or a peaceful sanctuary - or perhaps an addictive pastime!
Whether you have a small courtyard or a country estate, I believe that a well-designed garden
should form an extension of your home. I work with my clients to capture their needs and
aspirations, and translate them into reality, creating gardens to suit their lifestyle and their
environment.
Based in the leafy suburbs of Liverpool, I am a garden designer offering a comprehensive range
of garden services across the north-west, which I tailor to your requirements with complete
flexibility – you may want a full landscape design, a garden makeover, colourful planting schemes
or perhaps help with a tricky area.  Or maybe you are looking for a wildlife-friendly garden,
somewhere to grow fruit and veg, a green wall, a water feature...the options are endless.
Whether you’re considering a modernist contemporary look or prefer a romantic classical feel,
from Mediterranean or prairie, cottage or jungle, I’d love to help you create your perfect garden!
